name: codex-routecraft
description: RouteCraft Core with Verification Budgets, separable local Praxis Memory and Praxis Dashboard, durable execution graphs, and optional Control Center telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Separable routing core, private experience memory, local dashboard, durable graphs, and optional telemetry.
interface.longDescription: RouteCraft for Codex keeps one compatible Local Runtime while exposing three additive boundaries: RouteCraft Core for routing hints, Verification Budget selection, and execution control; Praxis Memory for independent local experience data; and Praxis Dashboard for source-neutral versioned event projection. It also provides Sol-led orchestration, evidence-driven durable execution graphs, bounded companion-agent delegation, checkpoints and resume, selective retry, hooks, diagnostics, benchmark execution, and safe security checks. The 0.6 single-node fast path, existing Memory Local and Decision Store formats, and Collector v1-v5 remain available. Core behavior is supported without Praxis components or the separately versioned Control Center Add-on; optional delivery never blocks local execution.
